description: Data a library produces that outlives a run (saved state, cooked data): how it is keyed so that a change of library version or build rebuilds it.

produces.description: The data the library produces that is saved or cached.

version_source.description: Where glue reads the library's version and build from, at compile time.

rules.text: Data the library produces is keyed by a rebuild key that includes the library's version and variant, so a newer version or another variant never reads data written by the old one.
